axes: local x forward y left; world displacement rotated by current yaw
diffusion: 10-step squaredcos DDPM epsilon prediction; model.sample initializes torch.Generator(device=context.device).manual_seed(seed) and uses same generator in scheduler.step
goal_mlp_input: goal.float() raw robot-local meters, no additional scale; 2->128 GELU->256 token
goal_token: DEM CNN frame tokens + goal MLP token, positional encoding then 4-layer Transformer; no Quality token in reference
path: normalized action deltas denormalized with complete-only train mean/std then cumulative sum to 8x2 base-frame future XY
